identity.tagline: Designing expressive, high-performance and user-friendly experiences that just work — from idea to real world.

about: Dev Das is a fully fictional developer, designer and product builder. This demo showcases a customer-owned portfolio with flexible themes, a distinct profile image, local editing, and portable content. Future releases aim to bring modular hosting, automated backup, and recovery controls.

projects.name: Project Atlas
projects.description: A fictional planning dashboard demonstrating reusable interface components.
projects.caseStudy: Problem: make a large fictional work queue approachable. Approach: reusable dashboard components, accessible filters and clear summaries. Example outcome: a documented prototype.

projects.name: Greenline
projects.description: A sample accessibility-first community directory with clear navigation.
projects.caseStudy: Problem: present sample community information accessibly. Approach: plain-language navigation, keyboard-friendly interaction and inclusive layouts. Example outcome: an illustrative directory concept.

projects.name: Signal Notes
projects.description: A dummy note-taking concept that illustrates how portfolio entries can be edited.
projects.caseStudy: Problem: turn scattered notes into a manageable workflow. Approach: quick capture, structured tags and transparent export. Example outcome: a fictional developer productivity experiment.
